name: Soni Medicare Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, Soni Medicare Ltd is in the business of running Hospitals[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company runs Soni Hospital which is a 100 bed Corporate Multispecialty Hospital with NABH accreditation. It houses a modern women’s health & well-being centre for mother & child by the name JOY. SML provides equipment and facilities to patients for advance comfortable treatment processors in Cardiac, CT, and MRI etc.

cons: Stock is trading at 537 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -33.7% over last 3 years.
